fredDgs3mo.description: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 3-Month Constant Maturity, quoted on an investment basis

stateStreetOfficial.purpose: SPY benchmark objective and inception/listing context

methodology.signalRule: Use the completed raw close immediately before the execution session; ATH when that close is at least the running maximum raw close.
methodology.executionRule: next available raw open, normalized by same-day adjClose/rawClose
methodology.returnRule: Yahoo adjusted close/open proxy with distributions reinvested
methodology.forceBuyRule: For each ATH-deferred lot, after the first completed close on/after three calendar months from contribution, fill at the next session open if no threshold close occurred earlier.
methodology.drawdownMetric: raw close / running maximum raw close - 1
methodology.maxDrawdownMetric: daily unitized wealth after removing external contributions
methodology.xirrMetric: dated monthly contributions as negative cash flows and terminal asset as positive cash flow

conditionalForwardReturns.population: 매월 25일 정기매수 실행일 직전 완료 거래일의 시장 상태
conditionalForwardReturns.returnDefinition: 신호일 수정종가부터 목표 달력월 이후 첫 거래일 수정종가까지

bootstrap.method: circular moving-block bootstrap over the chronological monthly sample

rollingTenYearRobustness.definition: 매월 25일 기준 120회 납입 후 첫 납입월로부터 10년이 되는 달력일의 마지막 완료 거래일 평가; ATH 고점은 SPY 상장 이후 전체 이력 기준

coverage: three-calendar-month forced fill at next open
deferred-cash accumulation without duplication or omission
identical contribution dates and amounts across strategies

limitations: Yahoo adjusted history is a total-return proxy, not an institutional official index ledger.
The sample begins with SPY history in 1993 and excludes earlier S&P 500 regimes.
USD pre-tax only; KRW FX and Korean taxes are excluded by plan.
No bid-ask spread, slippage, market impact, or terminal sale cost beyond stated sensitivities.
